title: The Hollow Choir
author: Coral Underhill
blurb: Silas Voss, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
